description: This file defines the PredictionQueue class, which extends BaseQueue and manages job processing related to prediction flows, including generating agent flows, executing custom functions, and handling abort controllers.

classes.name: PredictionQueue
classes.description: A class extending BaseQueue to handle prediction-related job processing, including generating agent flows, executing custom functions, and managing abort signals.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the PredictionQueue with name, connection, and options, setting up Redis publisher and queue name.

methods.name: getQueueName
methods.description: Returns the name of the queue.

methods.name: processJob
methods.description: Processes a job, handling different types of data such as agent flow generation, custom function execution, or standard flow execution, with support for abort controllers.
